why_not_a_null: Matched NPIPE simulations are on the NERSC global filesystem (account needed) and are UNAVAILABLE. The half-ring difference contains noise only and gives ONE realisation per frequency, so no distribution, no signal (CMB cosmic variance) and no coverage can be formed from it.

inputs.maps: NPIPE R4.00 HFI Single-frequency full-ringhalf-1/-2 at 100, 143, 217 GHz (nside 2048, NESTED, Galactic, K_CMB, PROCVER npipe6v20); hashes in DOWNLOAD_MANIFEST_20261110.json (group planck_npipe_pr4)
inputs.mask: PR3 common Int TMASK applied to PR4 maps so the operator matches the PR3 lane; this is NOT the PR4/Hillipop mask (those masks are local but not used)
inputs.bad_pixels: none flagged (fraction 0.0 at all three frequencies)

operator.operator_steps: D=(HR1-HR2)/2; nside 2048->16 mean-degrade over valid children; same f_sky 0.716 mask; monopole+dipole nuisance; OLS on 5 STF basis maps; B* in the Gram metric

interpretation: Noise-only B* estimates are ~2e-8..5e-8 (Gram norm), about 3 orders of magnitude below the PR3 simulation null scatter (2.2e-5, dominated by CMB cosmic variance). At this resolution and mask the instrument noise is negligible next to the CMB signal variance.

The white-noise assumption fails: chi2 for 5 dof is 20-72 (expected ~5), i.e. chi2/5 = 4.1 (143), 11.4 (217), 14.4 (100): variance 4-14x and rms 2.0-3.8x larger than white-noise predictions. Any white-noise error bar would be too small by that factor; the noise in the fitted coefficients is correlated/scan-structured.
One realisation per frequency: these chi2 values are single draws and carry no uncertainty estimate here.
results_noise_only.comparison_caveat: PR3 (SMICA, FFP10 CMB+noise) and PR4 (HFI frequency maps, noise only) differ in release, processing and content; the comparison is only a magnitude check, not a consistency test.

claims.claim: NPIPE R4.00 half-ring noise propagates to B* at the 1e-8 level (Gram norm) under the PR3-lane operator; negligible vs CMB cosmic variance at nside 16.
claims.limit: one draw per frequency; PR3 mask; no beam

claims.claim: White-noise error bars are invalid for the 5 Bianchi coefficients on this operator.
claims.limit: chi2 5 dof 20-72; needs more realisations to quantify

claims.claim: A calibrated PR4 null, coverage or detection statement can be made.

next_gate: Either obtain NERSC access for the NPIPE simulations, or define a declared hybrid null (synthetic Gaussian CMB from a stated C_ell + noise realisations from a validated noise model) and label it SYNTHETIC; read the NPIPE beam/transfer-function documentation before any beam-bound claim.
